resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources give 1939 (Hartig 1981, quoted on the Idaho County list), 1940 (firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts) and 1935 for a 10-foot L-4 entry (Clearwater list). The story reports all three and does not choose one. Hartig's 1935 entry describes a tent-quartered lookout, so the Clearwater 1935 date may refer to that earlier structure; no source says so.
The Clearwater list says it burned in 1954; Hartig says it was condemned and burned in 1955 or 1956. The story reports both and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Brief record county 'Idaho' should read 'Idaho County'. The Rhoda Point log cabin is a different structure 2 miles southeast of the summit and is reported as 'still there' by an undated firelookout.com listing; it is not a remnant confirmed on the summit. Hartig's 1981 history (quoted on the Idaho County list) is second-hand here, not checked against Forest Service records. The 1939/1940/1935 build dates and the 1954 versus 1955-56 burn dates are unresolved; the story reports the disagreement. The 'Minnie Willson' 1947 to 1948 staffing is from Idaho Fire Lookouts only.
